question: What effect does merely seeing the Gaṅgā have on all that was previously described?
premises: All that was mentioned is the subject.
The cause is merely the sight of the Gaṅgā.
inference: Merely seeing the Gaṅgā destroys all that was previously described.
uncertainties: Whether destruction refers to sins, obstacles, or prior conditions is not specified.
plain_english: All that is destroyed merely by the sight of the Gaṅgā.
